description: Find the visa routes a person qualifies for from their profile. Returns the top matches ranked by estimated eligibility, with timeline, cost, official sources and a link to track the chosen route on transita.app. EU citizens see freedom-of-movement options first. Read-only: nothing is stored. Scores are estimates, not legal advice or a decision.

citizenship.description: Nationality as a word or country name, e.g. 'Indian' or 'India'.

current_country.description: Country the person lives in now, e.g. 'United Arab Emirates'.

income_usd.description: Gross yearly income in US dollars, e.g. 85000.

language_test.description: English test result in that test's own scale, e.g. {test: 'ielts', listening: 8, reading: 7.5, writing: 7, speaking: 7}. Sharpens routes with a language bar.

target_countries.description: Destination country codes to focus on, e.g. ['de', 'nl']. Leave out to search all.

timeline.description: When the person wants to move, e.g. '1year'.

wants_pr.description: True to keep only routes that lead to permanent residency, e.g. true.

work_field.description: Main field of work, e.g. 'software engineering' or 'nursing'.

work_years.description: Total years of full-time work experience, e.g. 5.

name: transita_match_visas
title: Match visas
